title: Conditional κ = 0.001636542223442109: second jp8-family supplier replaces the CK call (twin dispatch) on PR637
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001636542223442109** (conservative 0.001636542220572773). This is +1.87×10⁻⁸ over PR641 (0.001636523543003976), using the same code and words as PR637's st2u4 package and a different second provider.

**Change: twin dispatch.** The verifier requires at least two suppliers, so earlier packages paid for one CK call. Here that call is filled by **jp8b**, a second, independently built jp8-family supplier: PR635's (st2) jp8 word, rebuilt through the full pinned chain with its own local audit, wrappers and phases. Dispatch is jp8 ×71 / jp8b ×1. All 23 core admission files and verify.py are byte-identical to PR637; only data changes.

**Why it is a genuine second provider.** `witness.partner()` uses the second provider for substitution controls. jp8 and jp8b differ in every substituted field (program hashes in both orientations, paid profile, widths, all artifact and semantic hashes). The strict run rejects all 114 assembly controls (including stale_partner_program for both jp8 and jp8b) and all 23 audit mutations, 16 of them partner controls. An independent reviewer judged this SOUND conditional on exactly that strict result.

Owner map: exact-window MIP warm-started from PR637's map; idle {12:1, 32:1, 48:2228}.

## Verification

```sh
research/complex-571-cold14-twin/verify.sh /tmp/complex-571-cold14-twin ..   # SOURCE_ROOT holds worktrees pr568 pr569 pr571 pr575 pr583 at the pinned commits
```

Local result (Windows, CPython 3.11.11): the commit was preflighted from a fresh clone first (committed blobs equal the MANIFEST, every file LF, pin check passes, `spec.py check` OK). The official run from that clean clone passed all 58 stages with no reuse (the CK stages are absent because CK is not dispatched); the receipt manifest_sha256 e9e38dd802b385ac… equals the committed MANIFEST. PASS_COLD14_NATIVE_COMPLEX_AND_CITED_BIT, κ = 0.001636542223442109.

GitHub CI has not run, and I make no claim about it.

Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2) directed and reviewed it and is submitting it.

## Scope

The result is conditional on the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape/exact recovery, analytic transfer and the bit H1–H5 assumptions. It builds on PR604, which is not merged. It is finite exact evidence, not an unconditional theorem, a complete Lean proof, or a practical speedup.
